annotations.evidence: the maintainer's print read 2026-10-22: "same issue as p609" The note points at P00609's: a letter neither a complete yod nor a vav. Every alternate has the vav (`צַוַּר`, `צַוְּרָא`, `צַוּו׳`), and R00176 reads `v. צַוַּאר`, this entry's patah; it stands between R00151 `צַוָּאר` and R00153 `צַוַּארְנוֹיָיתָא`, where `צואר` sorts and `ציאר` does not. 1265b · leaf 588.
